releases.name: Clarity
notes: Light is now the default, with an optional remembered dark theme.
A quieter design with warm white surfaces, sage accents, serif headlines and rounded story cards.
Compact introduction and floating navigation; editions open immediately without a loading screen.

releases.name: Editorial
notes: New newspaper-inspired layout with a bold JARVIS masthead, paper backgrounds, fine dividers and a red accent.
Image-first lead stories, compact thumbnail rows and side-by-side Global and India sections on desktop.
Retains dark mode, story sheets, saved stories, filters and archive.
Clarifies editor-verified labels and the curated edition note.

releases.name: Verified 24-hour edition
notes: Rebuild November 2 for the requested rolling 24-hour window with publisher-page verification.
Exclude stale and inaccessible sources; retain rejection reasons.

releases.name: Lounge
notes: Premium lounge design: warm charcoal and champagne-brass palette, Fraunces serif display, glass header and floating tab bar
Full-bleed lead story and ranked story list with thumbnails
Publisher images shown from the source with credit, falling back to the JARVIS cover
Refresh button: checks for a newer edition and shows when the next one is due
Initialising screen with edition boot sequence

releases.name: Launch
notes: Daily automated editions at 07:30 Doha with verification gate
Global and India sections, category filters, saved stories, archive
Launch edition No. 001 hand-verified against publishers
